items.title: Share dialog opens from Feed action row
items.precondition: Signed in; feed shows a mutual friend's original post (not a share wrapper)
steps: Click Share2 on friend's post action row
items.expected: SharePostDialog opens with caption textarea, original post preview, Cancel and Share post buttons.
items.evidence: FeedPage.tsx wires PostCard onShare → openShare → SharePostDialog; PostActionRow renders Share2 when onShare provided. Code review + frontend typecheck pass (2026-08-03).

items.title: Share with caption appears on feed with caption + nested embed
items.precondition: SharePostDialog open on friend's text or image post
steps: Enter a non-empty caption in the dialog
items.expected: New wrapper card shows ShareAttribution line, caption body text, and nested SharedPostEmbed of the original.
items.evidence: confirmShare posts { body: caption.trim() } to POST /api/posts/:id/share; PostService.share stores trimmed caption on wrapper; PostCard renders ShareAttribution + body + SharedPostEmbed.

items.title: Share with empty caption (body omitted) works
items.precondition: SharePostDialog open; caption left blank or whitespace-only
items.expected: Share succeeds; wrapper body empty; nested original still renders; attribution line present.
items.evidence: SharePostDialog onConfirm passes caption.trim() (empty string); PostService.share: input.body?.trim() ?? '' when body omitted from payload; sharePostSchema body is optional.
items.notes: Frontend sends { body: "" } for empty caption; API also accepts omitted body via parse(raw ?? {}).

items.title: API rejects body > 5000 chars
items.precondition: Authenticated session; valid friend post id
items.expected: 400 POST_VALIDATION from Zod; share not created.
items.evidence: sharePostSchema in PostService.ts: z.object({ body: z.string().max(5000).optional() }); ZodError → PostsController handle → 400 POST_VALIDATION. SharePostDialog maxLength=5000 prevents oversize from UI.
items.notes: Documented from sharePostSchema; no live API call in this session.

items.title: Share forbidden on own post / non-friend
items.precondition: Code review of share authorization path
items.expected: Own post → SHARE_FORBIDDEN; non-friend → SHARE_FORBIDDEN; share wrapper → SHARE_FORBIDDEN. UI hides Share2 via canSharePost.
items.evidence: PostService.share: author_id === viewerId → SHARE_FORBIDDEN; !areFriends → SHARE_FORBIDDEN; shared_from_post_id set → SHARE_FORBIDDEN. canSharePost: post.author.id !== viewerId && !post.sharedFromPostId. Route uses requireAuth.

items.title: Post detail share opens same dialog
items.precondition: Open /posts/:id for a friend's original post
steps: Click Share2 on post detail action row
Confirm SharePostDialog opens (same component as Feed)
items.expected: PostDetailPage uses SharePostDialog with same caption composer and confirmShare flow.
items.evidence: PostDetailPage.tsx imports SharePostDialog; openShare/onShare + confirmShare mirror FeedPage pattern.
